meaning:
Jebus = "threshing place"
an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'
Another name of ye.ru.sha.laim (יְרוּשָׁלִַ֫ם, יְרוּשְׁלֵם "Jerusalem" H3389)

renderings.kjv: And when they were by Jebus

elsewhere.note: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also…
David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
